findings.quote: We support the General Assembly resolution establishing the global dialogue on AI governance and welcome the work being done by the independent international scientific panel on AI.
findings.rationale: Supports UN AI governance institutions in response to technological transformation.

findings.quote: We have launched, with UN support, a national artificial intelligence strategy and a national fintech strategy.
findings.rationale: Connects a UN-supported national AI strategy to inclusive governance, equitable benefits and collective risk management.
